summary: Phase 8 (final, 8 of 8) ran the full CI gate against the whole Cslib library for the first time in this task and re-verified every stated exit invariant with a command that actually ran. lake build succeeds (3259/3259 jobs, whole-library target); lake build Cslib...Nested.Soundness succeeds standalone (734/734 jobs, zero errors, zero warnings). bash .claude/scripts/lean-sorry-census.sh Cslib reports sorry_count: 40 (down from the 41 baseline), with no Nested/Soundness.lean entry anywhere in the inventory -- the task's headline invariant. #print axioms on nested_sound_impL, nested_sound_cut, and nested_sound (run via lean_run_code with 'open Cslib.Logic.Modal') all report only the three standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), no sorryAx. A scoped git diff of this task's four declared-owner files against no new 'axiom' declarations came back empty (all textual 'axiom' hits are docstring prose). lake exe checkInitImports and lake exe mk_all --check both pass cleanly. lake test passes (exit 0, all 9253 targets including CslibTests). lake lint and lake exe lint-style each report exactly 2 errors, both at LoopChecking.lean:106-107 (space-before-semicolon inside a markdown-fenced shell snippet in a docstring) -- confirmed via git log/git blame to be landed by task 559 and never touched by any of this task's eight phase commits, hence out of scope and recorded rather than silently fixed. lake exe lint-style turned out to BE a defined target (a deviation from the plan's stated expectation that it was not). bash scripts/pre-pr-check.sh steps 1-3 ran and reported only pre-existing, out-of-scope items (including the anticipated FrameSoundness.lean:1270 sorry); step 4 fails on a stale hardcoded 'lake build Cslib.Logics.Bimodal.Metalogic' target -- that barrel file has never existed in this repository's git history (Bimodal/Metalogic is a directory) -- a pre-existing script defect this task did not cause and is not one of the plan's own exit-criteria commands. The plan's optional D2-counterexample regression hardening (a CKValidFC cs5FC'' instance against cs5_soundness_derivable'') was attempted-then-dropped per its own explicit escape hatch: unlike every other Preserved Asset in this plan, research never attempted or compiled it, and it requires building a fallible-world model from scratch with no compiled starting point. All 8 phases are now [COMPLETED]; the plan-level Status is set to [COMPLETED]; the task's headline invariants (census 41 to 40, RED build to GREEN, sorryAx-free, no new axioms) are all independently re-verified at this final gate.
